results.title: King Charles reportedly ‘gutted’ over Harry and Meghan’s UK return: Why the family reunion is still complicated
results.description: A report by claims that Charles is feeling “very let down” because he has not spent as much time with Prince Archie and Princess Lilibet as he had hoped. The report cites an unnamed royal insider, who says the King was keen to make up for lost time with the children.

results.title: New Dad Ranveer Singh Gets Into Navratri Spirit, Flaunts Garba Moves With Nita Ambani At Mumbai Event – VIDEO
results.description: New dad Ranveer Singh embraced the festive spirit at Mumbai’s Swadesh Eros event hosted by Nita Ambani. The actor’s Garba moves with Nita went viral, while his pink ethnic look grabbed attention. Sanjay Dutt, Aamir Khan, Kriti Sanon and other celebrities also attended the celebration.
